decision_rule: No interpretation below 0.90 confidence becomes binding without a follow-up owner decision.

homepage_audience.architecture: The homepage leads with the expert-rated-data programme, LMCA-based method, AI-reasoning objective, and research outputs. General philosophy users receive a prominent separate route for structured philosophy, argument browsing, candidate critiques, and non-expert ratings.
homepage_audience.provenance_boundary: Candidate critiques and non-expert ratings must remain visibly and technically segregated from expert-rated records.

phase_2_expert_validation_gate.expert_validation_activation: Requires a new explicit owner decision plus documented qualified capacity sufficient for the complete 400-critique human-rating, replacement, adjudication, and operations workload.

funder_specific_timing.emergent_ventures: Prepare now; consider submission after bounded senior methodological feedback and meaningful interim pilot evidence.
funder_specific_timing.long_term_future_fund: Prepare now; consider submission after the complete 48-critique pilot, final agreement and operations analysis, and bounded senior feedback.
funder_specific_timing.manifund: Consider only after a clearly bounded public tranche and credible public evidence or endorsement exist.
funder_specific_timing.submission_control: No application may be submitted without a separate explicit approval from Ellen Sun.

pilot_start_semantics.gate_precedence: The previously approved production-path and pre-outreach gates remain mandatory. If they are not passed, the real-rating start date slips automatically rather than weakening the gates or treating calibration or rehearsal as research data.

rail_policy.us_recipients: ACH or domestic bank transfer where available

personal_payment.china_account_policy: Do not use the China-held account for Pilot 01 unless a specific payment requires it and a separate payer-recipient compliance review approves it.

immediate_engineering_priority: Complete and verify the authenticated staging rater journey and all production-path pre-outreach gates before any real research rating or rater invitation.
